value.rationale: The original sharp-dimension existence theorem naturally motivates determining all invertible extremizers. At the exact threshold the theorem excludes every more complicated spectral graph and nonsemisimple possibility, gives the canonical one-cycle normal form, counts all spectral translation classes for all coprime p,q, and produces scalar-power rigidity. This complete equality-case classification is stronger than routine verification of a known construction or re-expression of the p+q threshold.
